name: TimePicker
usage: Reminder times, opening hours, scheduled tasks

props.name: value
props.description: The picked time (controlled), `HH:mm:ss`, or `HH:mm` when `format` has no seconds; `null` when empty.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial time (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new time; `null` when cleared.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while there is no value.

props.name: format
props.description:
Display format using dayjs tokens, such as `HH:mm`. When the format omits seconds, the value and onChange
output also omit seconds (`HH:mm`); otherwise they use `HH:mm:ss`, regardless of the display format.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Step of the minute column, such as `15` for quarter hours.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while there is a value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin
border) or `borderless`.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.

props.name: block
props.description: Fills the width of the container.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid`: on the root element of Select, TreeSelect, Cascader and AutoComplete, on the
input of DatePicker and TimePicker, and on an element that adds no box around the two inputs of a range picker.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the input when it mounts.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input gets the focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses the focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Called on key presses in the input.

members.name: TimePicker.RangePicker
members.summary:
Picks a time range in one field with a start and an end, such as working hours. The value is a pair of strings
in the same format as TimePicker, `['09:00:00', '18:00:00']` (or `['09:00', '18:00']` when `format` has no
seconds); `null` when empty.

props.name: value
props.description: Start and end times (controlled); `null` when empty.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial range (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new range; `null` when cleared.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Texts shown in the start and end fields while there is no value.

props.name: format
props.description:

output also omit seconds (`HH:mm`); otherwise they use `HH:mm:ss`, regardless of the display format.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Pick a time from the columns, or type it and press `Enter`.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Format, step and range
examples.description:
`format="HH:mm"` hides the seconds, `minuteStep` sets the interval, and `TimePicker.RangePicker` picks a start
and an end time.
